description: This file defines the class `FormatWithEmptyString` which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. The class provides a method `getFormattedValue` that always returns an empty string, serving as a formatter strategy within the OrangeHRM maintenance purge system.

classes.name: FormatWithEmptyString
classes.description: A formatter class that implements the ValueFormatter interface, always returning an empty string as the formatted value.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns an empty string regardless of the input value.
